title: bursera subpubescens
intro: Bursera subpubescens, commonly known as the "Santos" or "Gumbo-limbo", is a species of flowering plant in the family Burseraceae. It is a tree native to the tropical regions of Central and South America, valued for its medicinal properties and versatile uses. The health benefits of Bursera subpubescens include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various ailments such as wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
